_comment: Phase 3A candidates H, I and J — the final predeclared additions to the geometry landscape. Each was dispositioned by the RELEASE GATE first: official runnable inference code AND official pretrained weights must both exist before any attempt to execute. Nothing here was reproduced from a manuscript, no missing component was implemented, no unofficial reproduction was substituted, and no published benchmark number is treated as a measurement on this project's footage. After these three, the Phase 3A model landscape is FROZEN.
_naming: Two distinct 2026 methods are called Wat3R/WAT3R. `Wat3R-Ren` (Ren et al., ECCV 2026 Oral) is configuration E, which WAS executed. `WAT3R-Xu` (Xu et al.) is configuration J below. They are never referred to as just 'Wat3R'.

_status_vocabulary.executed: ran on the Phase 3A clips and produced comparable output
_status_vocabulary.paper_only / not_released: official implementation or required weights unavailable
_status_vocabulary.pending_cuda: faithful released implementation exists but requires an unsupported CUDA runtime
_status_vocabulary.integration_failed: a supposedly supported path was attempted but could not be made to execute within bounded effort
_status_vocabulary.executed_but_invalid: ran, but conventions/numerics failed validation strongly enough that comparison would mislead

H_seavggt.name: SeaVGGT
H_seavggt.hypothesis: Does physics-driven / self-supervised underwater adaptation of a VGGT-family model improve restoration-relevant geometry relative to vanilla VGGT and the other underwater-adapted methods? Sits on the underwater ADAPTATION axis (VGGT -> SeaVGGT), alongside VGGT -> Wat3R-Ren.
H_seavggt.not_a_refraction_experiment: Self-supervised radiometric/physics-aware adaptation is not non-central refractive ray geometry. Configuration C remains the explicit flat-port camera-model experiment.

paper.venue: OpenReview submission (title: 'Underwater Visual Geometry Estimation with Self-...'); no accepted venue confirmed at inspection time
paper.claimed_adaptation: self-supervised adaptation of a pretrained depth model to underwater conditions with no ground-truth annotations, using cyclic consistency between original and reconstructed images under the underwater image-formation model, plus input-conditioned prototype refinement across water types
paper.claimed_result: 13.47% RMSE reduction versus the VGGT baseline under unseen water conditions (FLSea, USOD10K, SQUID)
paper.note: These are the AUTHORS' claims, restated for the record. They are not measurements on this project's footage and are not used in any ranking.

repository.license: NO LICENSE FILE. GitHub reports no licence. README content is the single line '# SeaVGGT'.

release_gate_evidence: demo.py imports `uw_model`, `dataset` and a top-level `vggt` package. NONE of the three exists anywhere in the repository — the released code does not import, let alone run.

The only checkpoint reference is a hard-coded local training artifact: `model_path = "checkpoints/epoch_01_best_rmse_0.6133_24proto_sota.pth"`. There is no `checkpoints/` directory, no download URL and no Hugging Face reference.
The GitHub releases API returns zero releases, so no weights are attached there either.
The only weights the code CAN fetch are vanilla `facebook/VGGT-1B` (demo.py line 236), i.e. the baseline, not SeaVGGT.
H_seavggt.disposition: Required pretrained weights are not publicly available and the released code is incomplete. Under the release gate this stops here. Implementing the missing modules would be a hand-written reproduction, which is not a controlled evaluation of the published method.

I_water_vggt.name: Water-VGGT
I_water_vggt.hypothesis: Does explicitly conditioning feed-forward geometry on learned water-condition / water-optics information improve spatial range structure on underwater footage?
I_water_vggt.what_the_paper_claims: A 'Water Condition Vector' representing refractive parameters, visibility, scattering intensity and spectral attenuation, driving an 'alternatingly conditioned Transformer backbone' that adapts feature interactions and geometric reasoning, plus condition-aware prediction modules.
what_the_released_code_actually_does: `vggt/` in the repository is a copy of the VANILLA VGGT package (dependency/, heads/, layers/, models/, utils/).

demo.py constructs a plain `VGGT()` and loads `https://huggingface.co/facebook/VGGT-1B/resolve/main/model.pt` — vanilla VGGT-1B weights. There is NO code path anywhere that loads a Water-VGGT geometry checkpoint, and the README's OneDrive 'pretrained Water-VGGT model' link has nothing in the code that would consume it.

The only Water-VGGT-specific component actually wired in is `wcv_init()`, which runs the committed `pre/wcv_pre.pth` (20 MB, in-repo) over an input directory and writes IMAGE files to another directory. The released pipeline is therefore 'WCV image-space preprocessing -> unmodified vanilla VGGT'.

The custom modules that would constitute the conditioned backbone (`attention.py::NonLocalSparseAttention`, `deform_conv.py::DCN_layer`, `swing_transformer.py`) are not imported by demo.py at all — they are orphaned files.
README states verbatim: 'Note: Training and testing code will be released upon acceptance of the paper.'
I_water_vggt.camera_model_finding: IMPORTANT: whatever the paper claims about refraction, the RELEASED implementation does not alter ray geometry, does not predict refractive parameters at inference, and does not model a non-central projection. The WCV is an image-space module feeding an unmodified CENTRAL pinhole VGGT. Water-VGGT must therefore NOT be described as 'refraction-aware SfM' on the strength of this release. Configuration C remains the only clean central-vs-flat-port experiment in this bakeoff.
hardware_evidence: demo.py raises unconditionally without CUDA: `raise ValueError("CUDA is not available. Check your environment.")`
wcv.py: `model = wcv_pre().cuda()` then `nn.DataParallel(model, device_ids=[0,1])` — requires TWO CUDA devices.
I_water_vggt.disposition: Recorded as paper_only / not_released on the PRIMARY ground that the released inference path does not instantiate the published method — it runs stock VGGT-1B after an image-preprocessing step, and the authors state the testing code is unreleased. The CUDA/two-GPU gate is a separate, independent blocker. Running it as shipped would have produced vanilla VGGT numbers under a Water-VGGT label, which is exactly the 'executed_but_invalid' trap.

official_checkpoint_inspected.verdict: The officially distributed 'pretrained Water-VGGT model' IS vanilla VGGT-1B, byte for byte.
official_checkpoint_inspected.how: The README's OneDrive link was followed manually and the artifact inspected directly (experiments/week3_geometry/scripts/inspect_checkpoint.py, loaded with weights_only=True). No architecture or inference code was written to do this.

artifact.container: torch pickle; root object IS the state dict

water_vggt_specific_modules_present.note: ZERO tensors match any of the claimed Water-VGGT components. The inventory is exactly vanilla VGGT's.

identity_test_vs_facebook_VGGT_1B.compared_against: facebook/VGGT-1B model.safetensors from the local HF cache
identity_test_vs_facebook_VGGT_1B.conclusion: The checkpoint is not merely 'VGGT-like' or 'VGGT-initialised' — every one of its 1797 tensors is numerically identical to facebook/VGGT-1B. It contains no underwater adaptation of any kind.

official_checkpoint_inspected.licensing_observation: facebook/VGGT-1B is a NON-COMMERCIAL checkpoint. It is being redistributed here via an MIT-licensed repository's README as 'the pretrained Water-VGGT model'. Recorded as an observed fact; this project neither relies on nor propagates that redistribution.
official_checkpoint_inspected.effect_on_status: Status remains paper_only / not_released, now on ARTIFACT evidence rather than code inspection alone. Executing the released pipeline would have produced vanilla VGGT-1B numbers under a Water-VGGT label - identical to configuration E0, which this bakeoff already ran as its control.

J_wat3r_xu.name: WAT3R-Xu
J_wat3r_xu.hypothesis: Does explicitly coupling feed-forward underwater geometry with degradation adaptation / image-formation cues produce better restoration-relevant geometry than the other underwater feed-forward methods?

paper.title: WAT3R: Feedforward Underwater 3D Reconstruction
paper.authors: Jiayi Xu, Jiahao Lu, Ziqiang Zheng, Yihao Tan, Yaolong Zhu, Yuan Liu, Sai-Kit Yeung
paper.base_architecture: Pi3 (NOT VGGT), with the original point-prediction head replaced by a DPT head to remove grid artifacts
paper.geometry_outputs: pixel-aligned 3D point maps, relative camera poses (SE(3)), depth maps
paper.additional_outputs: restored/clean images via a neural degradation-adaptation module, plus water-parameter estimates (attenuation beta_att, backscatter beta_bs, background light B_inf)

release_gate_evidence: The arXiv abstract page carries no code repository, no weights statement and no code-availability statement.
The full arXiv HTML text contains no code-release, GitHub, or 'code will be released' statement.
The project page https://xujiayi777.github.io/WAT3R.github.io/ shows a 'Code' label in its header that is NOT a functional hyperlink — no URL, no repository, no checkpoint download.

A GitHub search for 'WAT3R' returns 12 repositories; the only relevant one is LSXI7/Wat3R (Ren et al., configuration E). The remainder are a T-cell receptor pipeline, a drink-water reminder app, a school KML file and profile configs. No Xu et al. repository exists.
J_wat3r_xu.not_an_ablation_partner: Wat3R-Ren adapts VGGT by cross-domain semi-supervised training; WAT3R-Xu builds on Pi3 with a degradation-adaptation module. They differ in base architecture AND in strategy, so even if WAT3R-Xu were runnable, Wat3R-Ren vs WAT3R-Xu would be a comparison of two different underwater-geometry SYSTEMS, never a clean architectural ablation.
J_wat3r_xu.week_boundary_note: Its water-parameter and clean-image outputs overlap Weeks 5-6. They are recorded here as prior art only. Phase 3A evaluates geometry, and nothing in this entry licenses starting attenuation inversion or backscatter removal.
J_wat3r_xu.disposition: No official runnable inference code and no released weights. Stops at the release gate. Not reproduced, not substituted with Wat3R-Ren, and its published numbers are not used as measurements on this project's footage.

_landscape_frozen: With H, I and J dispositioned, the Phase 3A model landscape is frozen. No further geometry model may be added, no GPU infrastructure rented, and no CUDA-to-MPS research port undertaken.
